subject: Pilot playbook: econ owner alignment, security checklist & champion talk tracks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot playbook: econ owner alignment, security checklist & champion talk tracks

Elena — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed playbook so we can align internal stakeholders at Brightlane and arm you as champion. Please confirm/edit the bold items below.

Call summary (high level)
- Goal: 6-week pilot focused on payment reconciliation use case to reduce manual matching and lower dispute resolution time.
- Primary metrics: reduce manual reconciliation time by 45%, reduce disputes by 30%, measurable per-month cost savings target (~$45k/mo estimated).

Stakeholder map (from today's convo) — please confirm names/roles:
- Economic buyer: Ravi Shah, VP Finance (decision authority for pilot spend)
- Security lead: Leah Patel (security & infra)
- Legal / contracts: Sam Cho (commercial and data/privacy)
- Procurement: procurement@brightlane.com (SLA/pricing gates)
- Champion / internal sponsor: Elena Torres (product operations)

Decision criteria we heard from your team:
1) Accuracy on reconciliation match rate (target >95% on pilot datasets)
2) Observable latency and cost per transaction (unit economics)
3) Data residency & access controls (SOC2 evidence required)
4) Clear rollback/fallback plan for operations

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) We will send: mutual action plan + ROI one-pager + SOC2 summary (attached). Please share the correct procurement contact for contracting turnaround and whether a SOW or PO will be required.
2) Technical deep-dive with Karthik (30 min) to validate data format and integration points — suggested slots Tue/Wed next week.
3) Elena — I'll include two short champion talk tracks below you can use when briefing Ravi and Leah.

Champion talk tracks (2 x 30s):
- For Ravi (econ buyer): “Pilot is a quick, measurable test to reduce manual reconciliation overhead. Based on our scoping, expected net savings ~ $45k/mo with low integration lift — we can structure the pilot so you only pay for the resources used during the test and get a clear ROI readout at 6 weeks.”
- For Leah (security): “Redwood operates under a SOC2-compliant runtime; we’ll provide the SOC2 summary and can run an on-site/recorded security review. Data does not leave your VPC for private deployments — we can scope encryption and access controls to match Brightlane policies.”

Attachments: Brightlane_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (MVP scope + timeline), RI_ROI_one-pager.pdf (high-level dollarized benefits), SOC2-summary.pdf

If the stakeholder list is accurate, I’ll send the MAP and one-pager now and book the technical sync. Thanks for championing this — small asks and clear timeline will help get Ravi comfortable.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook: econ owner alignment, security checklist & champion talk tracks

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications:
- Correct econ buyer: Ravi Shah (VP Finance). He'll want the dollarized ROI and a clear payment/commitment ask (avoid surprise spend).
- Security lead is Leah Patel (leah.patel@brightlane.com). She will need the SOC2 doc and a short security FAQ (bullet answers).
- Legal: Sam Cho (sam.cho@brightlane.com) is our primary; he typically requests an MSA + SOW for anything >$50k. Procurement copy: procurement@brightlane.com.

Timing: Ravi wants a one-pager and the MAP by Monday EOD so he can run it by his finance partner on Tue. Leah is available for a 30-min call Tue afternoon.

Can you also include a 2–3 slide ROI summary we can drop into Ravi's packet? That will help get him to a quick yes.

Elena
Product Ops, Brightlane Financial
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook: econ owner alignment, security checklist & champion talk tracks

Perfect — thanks for fast turnaround. Actioning now:
- Attached: RI_ROI_one-pager.pdf (we'll also drop a 2-slide PDF for Ravi this afternoon).
- Brightlane_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx attached with proposed dates (pilot kickoff week of 11/29).
- SOC2-summary.pdf attached for Leah.

Proposed micro-asks for you to brief Ravi quickly:
1) We ask for naming Ravi as the econ owner sign-off on the MAP (no financial commitment beyond pilot resource consumption).
2) Ask procurement whether an initial PO is required for pilot infra cost — otherwise we'll scope as usage + short term credit.
3) Confirm Leah's top 3 security questions (we can prep answers in <24h).

I'll send the 2-slide ROI and a calendar invite for a Tue 30-min security/technical sync with Karthik and Leah. If Ravi prefers a 15-min readout instead of the slides, we can do that too.

— Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: prep items for Brightlane pilot (SOC2 artifacts, demo checklist)

Ben / Karthik — internal checklist before the security sync: 
- Package SOC2-summary.pdf + SOC2 cert redacted copy (attach after legal OK).
- Prepare short demo script showing: data ingestion (S3 schema), reconciliation accuracy sample, rollback/fallback flow.
- Karthik: bring sample logs and performance numbers for sequence lengths (we expect Procurement/Leah will ask about latency at scale).
- I'll own the acceptance criteria section in the MAP and the pilot runbook.

I'll also draft a 2-slide ROI visual using the figures in RI_ROI_one-pager.pdf. Target: send calm, non-technical slides for Ravi.

— Monica
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brightlane.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook: econ owner alignment, security checklist & champion talk tracks

Ben / Elena — quick legal questions before we run a MAP/PO: 
1) Will Redwood sign our standard MSA or do you require Redwood's MSA? We prefer to start from our MSA and redline.
2) Data handling: confirm whether Brightlane data will be processed in Redwood's hosted environment vs. customer-managed VPC. If hosted, what encryption-at-rest keys are used?
3) Who is the contact for indemnity/liability caps?

If you can route a short answers doc + the MAP, procurement can estimate timeline. Thanks.

— Sam
General Counsel, Brightlane Financial
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@brightlane.com>, Leah Patel <leah.patel@brightlane.com>, procurement@brightlane.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook: econ owner alignment, security checklist & champion talk tracks

Sam / Elena / team — thanks, noted. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

1) MSA: We can start from Brightlane's MSA; I will have our legal team pick up the redline after we agree pilot scope. (Link to draft will be shared via DocuSign.)
2) Data processing model: Pilot will run in Redwood's hosted environment by default, but we can offer customer-managed VPC as an option for production. For the pilot, we recommend hosted with dedicated instance & encryption-at-rest using customer-provided KMS where required. (See attached SOC2-summary for controls.)
3) Indemnity / liability: Our legal lead is cc'd on the follow-up thread; for the pilot we typically limit liability to direct damages and agree to an expedited redline for pilot scope.

Next steps / owners: 
- Ben: send MAP + 2-slide ROI + SOC2 summary (done) and share HubSpot record + DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/link/abc123).
- Elena: confirm Ravi will review MAP Mon/Tue and share availability for a 15-min econ readout.
- Leah: confirm Tue afternoon slot for security sync with Karthik.
- Monica: finalize acceptance criteria in MAP and prep demo script.

Timeline target: pilot kickoff week of 11/29, legal redline and PO (if required) by 12/6 to keep momentum.

Thanks everyone — will follow up with calendar invites and a finalized MAP in the next hour.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
